Create a live-action cinematic revenge-comedy video set inside a busy Incheon-style Korean international airport terminal. Use realistic handheld camera movement, bright terminal lighting, natural airport ambience, expressive reactions, believable slapstick physics, and continuous real-time action.
Characters:
A stylish Korean woman in her mid-20s, long black hair in loose waves, wearing a fitted beige blouse, dark skinny jeans, white sneakers, and a crossbody designer bag. A cocky Korean man in his mid-20s, wearing a grey tracksuit, bold sneakers, dragging an oversized hard-shell suitcase. Maintain consistent faces, hairstyles, clothing, and proportions throughout.
Scene:
The woman stands near the check-in counters, sipping an iced coffee while scrolling through her boarding pass on her phone. The man rushes past, carelessly bumps her shoulder, knocking the coffee cup from her hand, and says dismissively, "Move out of the way next time."  Her drink spills across the floor as he smirks and keeps walking.
She calmly watches him go, picks up her dropped phone, and calls out, "You dropped something."
He turns back with a mocking grin. She nods toward his suitcase, whose extended handle has gotten looped around a nearby luggage cart. He laughs it off and yanks the suitcase hard — but the cart rolls the opposite way, spinning him around and sending his suitcase sliding away between two parked baggage carts.
Flustered, he storms back toward her demanding an apology. She steps aside just in time, and he stumbles onto an empty baggage-claim conveyor platform, landing safely on a stack of soft airport cushions. His suitcase bursts open behind him, spilling clothes, socks and an oddly large collection of plush toys across the platform.

镜头运动：镜头缓慢而稳定地在森林中穿行，捕捉树木之美、透过枝叶的光线以及飞舞的精灵。移动应当平稳，犹如在森林中滑翔，赋予观者探索与惊奇之感。

[负面提示] 精灵：不要过于明亮或卡通化的精灵。它们的光辉应柔和而空灵，而非刺眼。避免杂乱或快速的动作；精灵应优雅而平稳地飞翔。不要让过多精灵挤满场景。
